current_checkpoint_note: Farm Awareness / Satellite Field Intelligence campaign, baseline aa236f0 (Checkpoint 1.5 closed clean). Full account: docs/farm-return-next/FIELD_AWARENESS_ARCHITECTURE.md. Named 'Field Awareness' throughout (not the brief's own 'Farm Awareness') to avoid colliding with the existing, unrelated, already-shipped GPS Job Mode startFarmAwareness background-location capability. Decisive Phase 0 finding: real field-specific NDVI/vegetation-index computation is blocked by an already-decided, not-reopened hard policy prohibition on creating a CDSE account (docs/farm-return-next/BLOCKERS.md, 2026-09-01) -- there is no real crop-condition signal available today, at all, only real scene-discovery metadata (mission, acquisition timestamp, cloud cover, footprint-intersection-checked field coverage) from the existing satellite-field-coverage.ts/cdse-stac-client.ts (both unmodified). New: src/domain/field-awareness.ts (FieldAwarenessSnapshot/buildFieldAwarenessSnapshot -- freshness/attention/confidence derived entirely from real satellite-observation currency, never a fabricated crop-condition judgement; disclosed product-judgement thresholds in docs/evidence-register.md), src/orchestration/field-awareness/index.ts (getFieldAwarenessForCurrentUser -- verifies field ownership via the already farm_id-scoped listFieldsForFarm, never a new raw id-only query or RLS alone, before any satellite/activity call), src/app/actions/field-awareness.ts (thin Server Action), src/components/farm/FieldAwarenessCard.tsx (the one real farmer-facing surface, wired into FieldDrawer.tsx's existing 'Now' tab -- fetches once per fieldId, no polling). Reuses (unmodified): EngineOutcome/isOk, SatelliteFieldCoverage, ActivityType/CompletionType, listConfirmedJobSessionsForFarm, listFieldsForFarm, field-boundary.ts's boundingBox. No migration -- nothing persisted, computed on demand. Deliberately NOT built this campaign, all documented with rationale in FIELD_AWARENESS_ARCHITECTURE.md: Farm Map visual redesign/per-field attention overlay (item 7 -- no real per-field signal to justify it), live satellite calls inside FarmContext (item 15 -- performance/no caching layer yet; the snapshot type is ready for a future integration), Today/Prompt integration (item 10 -- no real, non-fabricated trigger condition exists), farmer-confirmation/learning hook UI (item 11 -- no mature learning layer to attach it to; the domain shape is ready).
